description: Publishes a governed national, state, and county baseline for annual Census Nonemployer Statistics.
retry: Exponential backoff for discovery and source acquisition; fail after four total attempts.
checkpoint: The source archive and derived artifacts are run-scoped; the manifest and current pointer publish only after all quality gates pass.
idempotency: Each build publishes one immutable release and atomically changes current.json only after success.
cancellation: Abort an active download or parse and retain no shared lock; unpublished staging remains isolated by run ID.
retention_profile: Retain immutable public aggregate releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
